# HTTP echo fixture

httpbingo-get.json is derived from a live HTTP GET response from httpbingo.org.
The origin was replaced with a TEST-NET address, run identifiers with test constants,
and headers with only the Host and single-value probe marker arrays.
No original IP, credentials, user agent or platform request identifiers are retained.
It verifies the Go response shape; it does not demonstrate Quantumult X routing.
